goal: Understand everyday spoken Japanese by ear, from clear comprehensible-input videos up to natural podcasts.

stages.name: Stage 1 · Listening toolkit
stages.why: Phrases that keep a Japanese speaker talking to you, slowly enough to follow.
stages.milestone: I followed a whole video in my zone without pausing.

phrases.nl: これは日本語で何と言いますか？
phrases.gloss: kore wa nihongo de nan to iimasu ka? · How do you say this in Japanese?
dou iu imi desu ka? · What does that mean?

phrases.nl: もう一度お願いします。
phrases.gloss: mou ichido onegai shimasu · One more time, please.

phrases.nl: ゆっくり話してください。
phrases.gloss: yukkuri hanashite kudasai · Please speak slowly.
yoku wakarimasen · I don't really understand.
naruhodo! · I see! / That makes sense!

stages.name: Stage 2 · How people really talk
stages.why: Fillers and casual forms fill real conversation. Once you hear them as filler, natural Japanese gets much easier.
stages.milestone: I can hear えっと and なんか as filler in a podcast.

recognize.gloss: wakannai · casual 分からない, “I don't get it”
shiteru · casual している, “is doing”

stages.name: Stage 3 · Topic playlists
stages.why: Narrow listening: the same vocabulary in many voices.
stages.milestone: I watched five videos on one topic in a week.
